document_notes: The page is page 283 of the PIR, containing the continuation of the entry for C. Avidius Cassius (the lemma itself is on the preceding page).

entries.relevance_notes: Explicitly identified as governing Syria with the title 'legatus Augusti pro praetore' ('Syriam administrat ... nomine legati Augusti pro praetore').

segments.identification_and_sources: dig. 2, 14, 60; Dio exc. 71, 3, 1; Philostr. v. soph. 2, 1, 13; Mommsen RG 5, 407 n.; Dio-Xiph. 71, 4; Vita Marci 21, 2; Avid. Cass. 6, 7; Clod. Alb. 6, 2; Epit. de Caes. 16, 11; Amm. Marc. 21, 16, 11; BGU 1, 55. 59. 119. 127; P. Grenf. 2, 58; Dio-Xiph. 71, 27, 3; Vita Comm. 12, 2; 2, 2; 12, 3; v. Marci 22, 12; 25, 2; Compt. rend. 1919, 356.
segments.offices_and_career: Syriam administrat; rector totius Orientis (τῆς Ἀσίας ἁπάσης) constitutus; nomine legati Augusti pro praetore; Bucolorum seditionem in Aegypto compressit; in Oriente et Aegypto rebellavit atque imperium sumpsit.
segments.governorship_attestation: Syriam administrat ... nomine legati Augusti pro praetore v. supra.
segments.family_and_social_relations: Filii: Heliodorus (vita Marci 26, 11), Maecianus (ib. 25, 4, cf. v. Avid. Cass. 7, 4, infra n. 1406); filia Alexandria (vita Marci).
segments.prosopographical_commentary: Detailed discussion of his rebellion in 175 AD, including chronological evidence from Egyptian papyri and ostraca (e.g., ostr. 2, pap. 2, pap. 1, Botti Catal. de monum. au musée d'Alexandrie 332, 498). Mentions his death by his own soldiers and his head being brought to Marcus Aurelius.

notes: The entry is a continuation from the previous page. He is the famous general of Marcus Aurelius who rebelled in 175 AD.

governorship_factoids.exact_text: Syriam administrat ... nomine legati Augusti pro praetore
notes: Administered Syria as legatus Augusti pro praetore.

career_factoids.exact_text: Ab imperatore Marco rector totius Orientis (τῆς Ἀσίας ἁπάσης) constitutus
notes: Appointed rector of the entire East by Marcus Aurelius after the departure of Lucius Verus in 166 AD.
Suppressed the Bucolic rebellion in Egypt.

career_factoids.exact_text: in Oriente et Aegypto rebellavit atque imperium sumpsit
notes: Rebelled and claimed the imperial title in 175 AD.

related_persons.relation_context: Emperor who appointed him and against whom he rebelled
Emperor whose departure in 166 AD is mentioned

entry_notes: This page contains extensive chronological discussion of the rebellion of Avidius Cassius in 175 AD based on papyrological and literary evidence.

problems.issue: PIR reference is null but should be 'A 1402' as this is the continuation of that entry.
Lemma 'AVIDIVS [CASSIVS]' is not exactly as printed. The page shows 'AVIDIVS' as a header, and the lemma is implied as 'C. Avidius Cassius' from the previous page.
problems.suggested_fix: Set lemma to 'C. Avidius Cassius' or 'Avidius Cassius' to match the authoritative source.

problems.issue: Province_text 'Syria' is correct, but province_normalized is missing in the factoid.
Date_normalized_end is set to 175, but the text suggests his governorship ended with his rebellion in 175, not necessarily at the start of the year.
problems.suggested_fix: Clarify the end date as '175' with a note that it ended with his rebellion.

problems.issue: Exact_text is slightly truncated. The full quote is 'Syriam administrat ... nomine legati Augusti pro praetore v. supra.'
problems.suggested_fix: Use the full quote: 'Syriam administrat ... nomine legati Augusti pro praetore v. supra.'

problems.issue: Status marker 'rector totius Orientis' is included but not explicitly tied to the governorship of Syria. The text states he was 'rector totius Orientis' after Lucius Verus left in 166 AD, which may imply a broader command.
problems.suggested_fix: Clarify in notes that 'rector totius Orientis' is a broader command encompassing Syria and other provinces.

problems.issue: Date_normalized_end for 'rector totius Orientis' is set to 175, but this role likely ended with his rebellion in 175, not necessarily spanning the entire period.
problems.suggested_fix: Set date_normalized_end to 175 with a note that the role ended with his rebellion.

problems.issue: Normalized_office 'dux' is not explicitly supported by the text. The text states he 'compressed' the Bucolic rebellion, but does not specify his title during this action.
problems.suggested_fix: Set normalized_office to 'legatus Augusti pro praetore' or 'governor' with a note that his exact title during this action is unclear.

problems.issue: Province_text 'Aegyptus' is correct, but province_normalized is missing.
Normalized_office 'usurpator' is correct but not a standard office. This is more of a descriptive term.
problems.suggested_fix: Retain 'usurpator' but add a note clarifying it is not an official office.
